header.title: YouTube Integration
header.subtitle: Auto-upload recorded live sessions to your YouTube channel. Connect once; every recording from this institute lands on your channel.

toasts.oauthStartFailed: Failed to start YouTube OAuth — check console.

featureGate.title: Enable YouTube Integration
featureGate.description: Turn this on if this institute wants to publish recorded live sessions to YouTube. When off, no recording is uploaded and no "Upload to YouTube" button appears on any session.
featureGate.hint: Once enabled, you'll be able to connect a YouTube channel, configure upload defaults (privacy, title template, category), and see the upload history of every recording.

connection.title: YouTube Channel
connection.description: Sign in with the Google account that owns the channel you want to publish to. Required: edit access to that channel.
connection.invalidDefaultReason: Google rejected the refresh token. This usually means access was revoked in Google Account settings.
connection.notConnected: No channel connected yet. Once connected, every BBB recording will auto-upload to that channel.

defaults.title: Upload Defaults
defaults.description: Applied to every recording that auto-uploads. Manual upload can override privacy per recording.

autoUpload.title: Auto-upload on recording ready
autoUpload.description: When off, recordings won't upload automatically. Anyone can still trigger an upload from the live-session view.

embeddable.title: Allow embedding
embeddable.description: Required if you want to play these videos inside Vacademy. Turn off only for download-restricted content.

publicStats.title: Public stats viewable
publicStats.description: Whether view-count / like-count are visible on the video page.

madeForKids.title: Made for kids
madeForKids.description: YouTube requires this declaration. Most adult-learner lectures should be off.

notifySubscribers.title: Notify channel subscribers
notifySubscribers.description: When on, YouTube pushes a subscriber notification for every uploaded recording. Usually off for routine recordings.

defaults.descriptionTemplatePlaceholder: Recorded session of {session_title} on {date}. © Your Institute.
defaults.playlistHint: Videos uploaded with auto-upload will be added to this playlist.

unlisted.label: Unlisted
unlisted.help: Anyone with the link can watch. Recommended for embed-only.

private.label: Private
private.help: Only you can watch. Use for review before publishing.

public.label: Public
public.help: Searchable on YouTube and your channel.

history.title: Upload History
history.description: Most recent 50 uploads for this institute. Failures can be retried; quota errors auto-retry after the daily window resets.
history.notConnected: Connect a YouTube channel to start uploading recordings.
history.empty: No uploads yet. Recordings will appear here once they finish processing.
